text:
jamie: Quick sync — we need a firm call on the admin multi-tenant UX for MVP. Two options: (A) cut from MVP and backfill in v1, (B) scope it down to a barebones admin view, or (C) push timeline 2 weeks to keep it. Thoughts?

sarah: leaning toward cut for MVP. customer pilots care more about inference stability and routing than fancy admin screens. :thinking:

mike: Cutting reduces ~3 sprint-worth of frontend + infra work. We can preserve a simple API for the piece so integrations don't break. If we cut, we should freeze the API contract now.

alexa: Design can ship a 1-page lightweight admin after MVP faster than a full-built UI. If we cut, I can deliver a responsive minimal view in 2 weeks for v1 backlog.

oliver: We do have telemetry gaps for admin events if we cut - analytics team will need a small event plan. Not a showstopper but flagging.

lily: Sales flagged two customers that asked for role-based controls. They said they'd be OK with MVP if we promise a prioritized v1 backlog item. They prefer a timeline over an unknown.

jamie: Proposal: cut full admin from MVP, keep a simple API contract and a tracking ticket; commit to v1 delivery window (target: 6 weeks post-launch). Quick poll: +1 cut, -1 delay, :question: scope-down.

mike: +1 cut. Also recommend we remove non-critical telemetry to reduce backend load for launch.

alexa: +1 cut -> I'll pair with PM on the UX stub for docs.

sarah: +1. We'll notify the pilots today and add an explicit note to the release notes and the sales FAQ.

oliver: +1 with telemetry plan: add `admin_action` event (minimal schema) so we can measure adoption when v1 lands.
lily: +1 but need a one-paragraph customer-facing commit we can share. Can someone draft?

jamie: I'll draft a short note: "We are prioritizing inference stability and routing for MVP; multi-tenant admin UI will ship in v1 (~6 weeks). We will provide an API and event hooks now." Will post in #sales and the pilot threads.

release-bot: deploy scheduled: v0.9.0 -> staging at 2026-04-12T17:00Z (info only).

sarah: Action items captured: 1) freeze admin API contract — @mike 2) add telemetry stub — @oliver 3) design stub & doc — @alexa 4) customer comms draft — @jamie 5) move feature flag gating — @eng-release (we'll handle).

mike: Note on freeze: I'll add an `admin-api/v1` swagger snippet in the repo and tag it `mvp-cut`.

alexa: I'll post the stub screenshot to the thread when ready.

jamie: Decision: cut full admin from MVP, ship lightweight API + hooks, commit to v1 window 6 weeks post-launch. Recording consensus: unanimous among respondents. :white_check_mark:

lily: Thanks — will update the two customers and keep them in the loop.

jamie: We'll re-evaluate if pilot feedback suggests re-prioritizing. For now, focus the launch on model stability, routing, and observability.

jamie: Pushing this as a short update to the roadmap doc and tagging the v1 ticket with `customer-promise` and `mvp-cut`.

sarah: Great, closing this thread. If anyone has blockers for the actions above drop a note here.
